overloads.semanticRole: The SET ABOUT command changes the About 4D menu command in the Help menu (Windows) or in the Application menu (macOS) menu to itemText .

constraints: method is called when the user selects the About 4D menu command after this call, in both Design and Application mode.
On Windows, this command modifies the "About 4D" line in the Help menu created by SET HELP MENU.
A new process is created when this command is run on a server machine.
